scenarios.name: subscriptions
scenarios.description: Cross-actor subscriptions: the hand-rolled intent fan-out baseline; the publisher's turn beside 1 to 1,024 subscriptions; commit-to-delivery latency; one pair's throughput; fan-in; subscribe churn; and a backlog drain across 64 subscribers.
